body:
Our first cohort of OpenAI Fellows has concluded, with each Fellow going from a machine learning beginner to core OpenAI contributor in the course of a 6-month apprenticeship.

### Official Announcement
Read the full update directly from the official source at [OpenAI News](https://openai.com/index/openai-summer-fellows-2018).

Stay tuned to [Modelverse](https://www.themodelverse.in) for real-time model analysis and benchmark coverage.
